# Axial Skyrmions

- The reflection methodology employed in this work modifies the sign of a single pion field, resulting in a relative phase definition that differs by π from previous studies [3, 12, 7], where all three pion fields undergo sign reversal to obtain the antiSkyrmion [3, 12, 7].
- This definitional approach provides a more natural framework for comparison with analogous monopole configurations, distinguishing it from earlier formulations.
- The profile function vanishes at radius s/2 from the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion) center, enabling continuous patching between Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion structures with fields achieving vacuum states outside each core region.
- Beyond the fundamental ansatz (3.7), enhanced initial conditions were implemented utilizing the rational map ansatz [11] incorporating axially symmetric charge n mapping.
